principles.title: Clarity over decoration
principles.description: If an element does not help someone understand or act, it has to earn its place.

principles.title: Accessibility is a material
principles.description: Contrast, keyboard access, and clear language are part of the design, not a final checklist.

principles.title: Ship the simplest useful thing
principles.description: A smaller, well-made release teaches you more than a large speculative one.

principles.title: Document the decisions
principles.description: Good documentation turns a one-off design into something a team can carry forward.
